name: Cucumber Extract
description: Cucumber Extract (CAS 89998-01-6 ), derived from Cucumis sativus, is a botanical ingredient sourced from fresh cucumber fruit and used across cosmetic, food, and nutraceutical applications. It delivers recognized moisturizing and flavoring properties that align with clean-label and natural formulation trends. Procurement teams source it as a ready-to-use botanical active for both topical and ingestible product categories. In personal care, it is incorporated into facial toners, eye gels, sheet masks, and after-sun products where its humectant character supports skin hydration claims. Food and beverage manufacturers use it to impart a fresh, green cucumber note in flavored waters, functional drinks, and savory snack seasonings for diverse consumer markets. Nutraceutical and wellness brands include it in supplement formulations targeting skin health and hydration positioning. Fragrance and flavor houses also draw on it as a botanical modifier. Cucumber Extract is available as a liquid, a dry powder, and a concentrated extract, with solvent and carrier type varying by intended application and formulation requirements. Standard grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with some suppliers offering standardized concentrations for formulators requiring batch consistency and reliability. Organic-certified material is commercially available for brands requiring certified natural or organic labeling compliance to meet specific regulatory and consumer standards.
